issue.title: [Enhancement] Update multiple licence year ends in one run.

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the bug, confirmed the fix guards against it with no regressions found, but Break My Fix found inputs that break try_update_year_range: a license_header_index past the end of the file raises IndexError, and a negative license_length still returns modified content. Look next at whether try_update_year_range should validate or bound license_header_index and license_length, a…

survivors.description: Initial flag is True when license length is zero, which is a wrong initial value.
survivors.diff:
--- a/pre_commit_hooks/insert_license.py
+++ b/pre_commit_hooks/insert_license.py
@@ -398,3 +398,3 @@
     current_year = datetime.now().year
-    changed = False
+    changed = license_length == 0
     for i in range(license_header_index, license_header_index + license_length):
survivors.words: pre_commit_hooks/insert_license.py:399: changing `    changed = False` to `    changed = license_length == 0` made no test fail; it behaves differently from the fix on inputs no test checks
